textLines: You toss the blue crystal into the hole, thanking your lucky stars you didn't sqander its power earlier!
Bright flashes of light pour out of the hole and thunderous explosive force pushes you backward.
You crawl from the rubble and slowly start to walk your way toward home.  It is now broad daylight.
The sun is beautiful and the birds are singing like you've never heard before!
Maybe that's just gratitude that it is finally over.  Then, you're sipping
coffee on your porch, safe from any demon possession.

textLines.text: You solved the mystery of the demonic invasion and survived!
